_comment: Global game rules. Times are seconds, angles degrees, distances world units.
_comment_wreck_hp: Hit points of a wreck as a share of the unit's. Shells and blasts wear wrecks, trees and rocks (hp in features) down; what they are worth goes with their hit points.
_comment_revive_cooldown: Seconds before the wreck of a revived unit, or of a revival site destroyed unfinished, can be revived again (scavengers would otherwise bring the same unit back over and over where it keeps getting killed).
_comment_debris: Buildings hit hard (one hit of at least min_hit of their hit points) or destroyed drop pieces of debris around them: reclaimable like wrecks, worn down by shells, the big ones (sight_size) block sight, falling ones hurt what they land on (land_damage per mass, at most land_damage_max). Their mass comes out of the building's wreck value: a hit drops hit_share of the value its damage stands for, hits drop at most max_shed of it in all, and a destroyed building drops death_share of what is left. At most max pieces lie around.
_comment_armor_angle: Armored units (unit category armored) take armor_front of a hit head on, armor_side from the side and armor_rear from behind, blended by the angle; the steeper a shell falls, the less the angle counts (straight down: 1).
_comment_splash: A shell with a blast radius does all its damage to the unit it hits. Units it did not hit take a share at the blast centre, fading to none at the edge: splash_direct for direct-fire guns (or the weapon's own splash), all of it for artillery, bombs and missiles. Armored units take splash_armored of any splash (also death blasts).
_comment_switches: Game features that can be switched off: terraforming, craters, wrecks left by destroyed units, hills blocking sight, trees/rocks/wrecks blocking sight, hills blocking radar, enemy buildings remembered from sight shown dimmed once destroyed out of sight (ghosts_show_destroyed, view only). near_sight: everything closer than this to a unit is seen regardless.
_comment_terrain: Craters: depth = crater_scale x sqrt(damage), never deeper than crater_max_depth below the original ground; 0 = no craters. Terraforming moves terraform_rate height per build power and second, at terraform_energy per unit, within terraform_max of the original ground.
_comment_points: Control points mode: units within cp_radius take a point in cp_capture_secs; every team starts with cp_start_points (the host can pick another number in the lobby); a team holding fewer control points than its strongest opponent loses cp_bleed points per second for each point of difference, nothing changes while they hold equally many; a team at 0 is defeated.
_comment_features: Reclaimable trees and rocks placed by maps. class: tree or rock (where the map generator puts it), shape: pine, broadleaf, bush or rock (procedural model), size scales the model, weight is how often the generator picks it within its class. Energy reclaims reclaim_energy_factor times faster than mass. hp: weapon damage it takes to destroy (times the map's scale for that tree or rock).
_comment_cover: Cover: a shot flying through a tree, rock or wreck loses that one's cover share of its damage (features: cover, default by shape - pine 0.3, broadleaf 0.35, bush 0.15, rock 0.65; wrecks: wreck_cover), and the cover takes it. Cover within cover_grace of the shooter does not count (units fire out from behind their own). Infantry (unit category infantry) standing idle or fighting look for cover within cover_search of where they were sent, against the nearest known armed enemy up to cover_threat_range away. Infantry thrown out of a destroyed building lose garrison_eject_damage of their hit points; inside it they take garrison_damage of every hit on it (their armor applies) and look from its roof with garrison_vision times their vision and binocular range. Infantry ordered into a building held by an enemy storm it: at the door they and the infantry inside trade their assault damage per second (unit JSON assault; the defenders deal garrison_defense times theirs), and once nobody is left inside they walk in.
_comment_preset: Relaxed preset, made by tools/relaxed_preset.py from the built-in data.
